free_text: Decision to proceed with biopsy for a 56-year-old man with PI-RADS 5, PSA 8.5 ng/mL, PSA density 0.368 and a prior biopsy status of 'None'. The panel protocol settled it by the rule 'cohort criterion (pirads_ge_3)' (EXPERT-COHORT); It matched the reading urologist in 24 of 24 labelled cases in exactly this situation (never biopsied). The conference did not return a readable structured form, so this record was completed from the minute alone; no finding is asserted beyond the values in it.
